answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 50-credit genesis tax before trading, a toll paid once like a fee for a voyage. One walnut costs little, but moving a thousand walnuts across a dune pays the toll a thousand times: 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits up front, gone if caught on day one. The tax halves only after 20 honest epochs, so fakes keep paying full price. An honest agent pays once, its earnings undiluted.
